cases.question: average speed per vessel
cases.sql:
WITH avg_speed AS (
  SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
  FROM telemetry
  GROUP BY vessel
)
SELECT vessel, avg_speed
FROM avg_speed
ORDER BY avg_speed

cases.question: how many readings per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS readings FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: what was the highest wave height
cases.sql: SELECT MAX(wave_height) AS max_wave_height FROM telemetry

cases.question: average water temperature across the fleet
cases.sql:
WITH avg_water_temp AS (
  SELECT vessel, AVG(water_temp) AS avg_water_temp
  FROM telemetry
  WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY vessel
)
SELECT vessel, avg_water_temp
FROM avg_water_temp
ORDER BY avg_water_temp

cases.question: minimum and maximum speed for each vessel
cases.sql:
WITH vessel_speed AS (
  SELECT vessel, MIN(speed) AS min_speed, MAX(speed) AS max_speed
  FROM telemetry
  GROUP BY vessel
)
SELECT vessel, min_speed, max_speed
FROM vessel_speed
ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: hourly average wind speed over the last 2 days
cases.sql:
WITH hourly_wind AS (
  SELECT 
    time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour,
    vessel,
    AVG(wind) AS avg_wind
  FROM 
    telemetry
  WHERE 
    ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '2 days'
  GROUP BY 
    hour, vessel
)
SELECT 
  hour,
  vessel,
  avg_wind
FROM 
  hourly_wind
ORDER BY 
  hour, vessel

cases.question: max wave height per vessel per day
cases.sql:
WITH daily_max AS (
  SELECT vessel, time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, MAX(wave_height) AS max_wave_height
  FROM telemetry
  WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY vessel, day
)
SELECT day, vessel, max_wave_height
FROM daily_max
ORDER BY day, vessel

cases.question: daily minimum and maximum water temperature
cases.sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT 
    time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day,
    vessel,
    MIN(water_temp) AS min_water_temp,
    MAX(water_temp) AS max_water_temp
  FROM telemetry
  WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY day, vessel
)
SELECT 
  day,
  vessel,
  min_water_temp,
  max_water_temp
FROM daily
ORDER BY day, vessel

cases.question: Aurora's average speed in 15-minute buckets over the last day
cases.sql:
WITH bucket AS (
  SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '15 minutes', ts) AS bucket, speed
  FROM telemetry
  WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day'
)
SELECT bucket, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM bucket
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

cases.question: average wind per vessel in six-hour buckets
cases.sql:
WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT 
    time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS ts,
    vessel,
    wind
  FROM telemetry
)
SELECT 
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '6 hours', ts) AS ts,
  vessel,
  AVG(wind) AS avg_wind
FROM hourly
GROUP BY 
  ts,
  vessel
ORDER BY 
  ts,
  vessel

cases.question: average speed by hour of day

  FROM

    ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days'

  vessel

cases.question: mean speed for the last 30 minutes in one-minute buckets

cases.question: which day had the strongest average wind
cases.sql:
WITH day AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM ts) AS day,
    vessel,
    AVG(wind) AS avg_wind
  FROM 
    telemetry
  WHERE 
    ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days'
  GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM ts), vessel
)
SELECT 
  day,
  vessel,
  MAX(avg_wind) AS max_avg_wind
FROM 
  day
GROUP BY 
  day, vessel
ORDER BY 
  day, max_avg_wind DESC

cases.question: correlation between wind and speed per vessel
cases.sql:
WITH vessel_speeds AS (
  SELECT vessel, speed, wind, time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour
  FROM telemetry
  WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days'
)
SELECT vessel, hour, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind, AVG(speed * wind) AS covar_sum, AVG(speed * wind) / (AVG(speed) * AVG(wind)) AS corr_coef
FROM vessel_speeds
GROUP BY vessel, hour
ORDER BY vessel, hour
